content.title: Book Recommendations
content.body:
A collection of personally recommended books with brief descriptions of their appealing qualities.

## The Road by Cormac McCarthy
A powerful post-apocalyptic novel featuring sparse but beautiful writing that creates an unforgettable atmosphere.

**Tags**: #fiction #post-apocalyptic #literature

## Pachinko by Min Jin Lee
A captivating multi-generational saga following a Korean family living in Japan, offering deep historical and cultural insights.

**Tags**: #fiction #historical-fiction #Korean-literature

## Dune by Frank Herbert
Features exceptional worldbuilding that justifies its status as a science fiction classic, creating a complex universe with political, religious, and ecological dimensions.

**Tags**: #science-fiction #worldbuilding #classics
